title: Center anything in three lines
why_it_matters: Centering is the classic CSS fight, and grid ends it.
explanation: Grid has a built-in shortcut. Make the parent a grid, then add place-items: center. The child lands in the middle both ways. The parent needs some height, otherwise there is no spare space to center inside.
try_it: Give a div a border, put a button inside it, and center the button with only these lines.
